annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions — A Drone Strategy 2.0
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions — A Drone Strategy 2.0
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Committee of the Regions (Rapporteur: Władysław Ortyl)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the EU Committee of the Regions on the Commission's Drone Strategy 2.0. It welcomes the strategy and urges a stronger role for local and regional authorities in U-space management, public acceptance, funding, green drone development, education and harmonised regulation, while flagging certification costs and dual-use concerns.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for coordinated regulation giving regional and local authorities autonomy to manage U-space and restrict drone use in certain areas
Urges more frequent Commission review of the drone market and future-proof, adaptable legislation
Recommends local consultative groups and a two-step rollout starting with high public-interest uses to build public trust
Calls for dedicated EU, national and regional funding streams for U-space and green drone solutions
Warns of overly costly drone certification and supports civil-defence-space synergies with transparency on dual-use technology transfer
